css: @page { margin: 2.5cm; size: A4; } body { font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 12pt; line-height: 1.8; color: #000; } h1 { font-size: 16pt; text-align: center; font-weight: bold; page-break-before: auto; margin-top: 40px; } h2 { font-size: 14pt; font-weight: bold; } h3 { font-size: 13pt; font-weight: bold; } h4 { font-size: 12pt; font-weight: bold; } p { text-align: justify; } table { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; margin: 15px 0; font-size: 10pt; } td, th { border: 1px solid black; padding: 5px 8px; vertical-align: top; } hr { page-break-after: auto; } pre { background: #f5f5f5; border: 1px solid #ccc; padding: 10px; font-size: 9pt; white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-all; } code { font-family: Consolas, monospace; background: #f0f0f0; padding: 1px 3px; font-size: 10pt; }
